irregularities.title: 10 player(s) have no official designation but do have an ESPN status
irregularities.detail: nfl.com printed a blank Game Status for these players (they practised without a designation), so this site renders them as ACTIVE and marks the designation as inferred. ESPN separately carries a news-derived status. This is a semantic difference between the two sources, NOT a data error, so it is reported once in aggregate rather than once per player.

irregularities.title: Game-day roster for DAL @ GB parsed zero athletes
irregularities.detail: ESPN answered from https://site.api.espn.com/apis/site/v2/sports/football/nfl/summary?event=401873007 but the payload contained no boxscore.teams[].athletes the parser recognises. The roster is skipped rather than guessed; if this persists the parser and the ledger probe need a look.

irregularities.title: 63 reporter claim(s) contradicted by the official report
irregularities.detail: These claims are retained (not deleted) because a contradicted claim is the evidence that drives a reporter's score down. Examples: SSBCrack said OUT for DJ Moore (official: see link); Los Angeles Chargers said ACTIVE for Daiyan Henley (official: see link); Falcons Wire said OUT for Kendal Daniels (official: see link); KSHB 41 Kansas City said ACTIVE for L'Jarius Sneed (official: see link); Yahoo Sports said OUT for Kendal Daniels (official: see link)

irregularities.title: Beat writer Sam Warren is attributed across 2 clubs (LV, BUF)
irregularities.detail: ESPN printed Sam Warren (Athletic) as the attribution on updates for multiple clubs. Local beat writers normally cover one club, so this is usually a shared-wire/aggregator attribution; it is kept as observed and flagged for manual review rather than reassigned by guesswork.

irregularities.title: Longest gap between collector runs is 3575 minutes
irregularities.detail: The workflow is scheduled every 5 minutes, but GitHub throttles and queues scheduled workflows, so this is the cadence the collector actually achieved over the archived runs. Alerts can only be as timely as this number: see the cadence panel on the site, which is fed from the same measurement.
